headline: IMPORTANT NEWS FOR CITIZENS OF SERBIA: Energy situation good, there will be no price increases
summary: Srbijagas director Dušan Bajatović said Serbia's gas storages are filled to the brim and are now being filled in Hungary. He said the regional and European gas situation is poor.
why: Srbijagas is Serbia's state gas company, so its supply position affects domestic energy prices and industrial gas costs.

original_headline: VAŽNE VESTI ZA GRAĐANE SRBIJE: Situacija sa energentima dobra, neće biti poskupljenja
